What we actually do for you

Every month, Jwero can:

  • Plan your campaigns.
  • Create your content.
  • Launch your campaigns.
  • Monitor performance.
  • Identify opportunities.
  • Optimise budgets.
  • Segment customers.
  • Send personalised communication.
  • Follow up with leads.
  • Measure results.
  • Recommend what to do next.
  • Find customers who are drifting.
  • Remember every occasion and scheme date.
  • Plan the reasons to get back in touch.
  • Write and send each message.
  • Follow up the replies.
  • Run the loyalty and savings schemes.
  • Measure who came back.
  • Recommend what to change.
  • Keep the catalogue and prices current at the live rate.
  • Add new pieces and collections.
  • Find products that are not selling.
  • Improve the listings.
  • Keep Google Shopping and marketplace listings in step.
  • Answer online enquiries.
  • Follow up carts left behind.
  • Report what sold and why.
  • Answer every enquiry, day and night.
  • Share the right pieces from your catalogue.
  • Send rate, scheme and order updates.
  • Run broadcasts to the right segment.
  • Follow up quotations.
  • Hand over to your team when a person is needed.
  • Keep templates approved and working.
  • Report replies, visits and sales.
  • Keep every customer on one record.
  • Merge duplicates and fill the gaps.
  • Score who is likely to buy.
  • Tell each salesperson who to call and why.
  • Keep segments up to date.
  • Log every conversation and visit.
  • Flag enquiries nobody has answered.
  • Report the pipeline.
  • Watch what is changing in search, social and ads.
  • Keep your Google profile and reviews in order.
  • Publish posts, Reels and stories.
  • Keep you findable in search and in AI answers.
  • Test what works and stop what does not.
  • Tie spend to enquiries and bills.
  • Report growth in plain numbers.
  • Recommend the next move.

This is the work, not the software. Which of it Jwero does for you, and which your team keeps, is your choice.

01 · Run it yourself

Your team, Jwero’s platform

For a showroom or small chain with its own team.

₹18,000 a month

First month ₹3,600. Billed monthly, excluding taxes.

  • Every product, one price. WhatsApp, counter, stock, POS, schemes, gold loans, workshop, books, team, marketing and communication. Nothing per module, nothing per seat.
  • Replaces the 10 to 15 tools most shops pay for today, so there is no other software to buy.
  • Adds the hands you have been trying to hire: AI and automation that take on the work of several people, with your team approving what matters. See how many for your shop →

03 · Chains, brands and groups

Your own Jwero, on your own servers

For many showrooms, brands or companies.

One-time licence

No recurring fee to Jwero. Support is optional. Rolled out branch by branch, with a pilot first and the season left alone.

  • The platform you would have built in-house, ready, with every module, your rules, your prices and your branches on one record.
  • Hosted where you decide: on your premises or in your own cloud. Jwero has no access to your data.
  • Security and privacy entirely under your policies: your access rules, backups and audits, with roles per branch and team and every action logged.
  • AI on your terms: run models locally, or connect the models you choose.
  • No dependence on a vendor. Our outages, price changes and roadmap stop being your risk.
